arguments.prompt: Create one isolated Cartoon water effect for SPLASH.BMP frame003. First input is the exact original sprite: preserve its particular silhouette, proportions, relative positioning of parts, open transparent areas and number of significant tongues/drops. White source shapes are actual foam; black background is transparent and any dark diagnostic contour must not become dark water. Required form: A taller irregular crown with a curling high foamy tongue left of center, narrow upright branching tips, a lower arc/bowl across the bottom, separated drops above and a small broken ripple to lower-right. Preserve the original open central negative spaces and asymmetric outline. This is a hollow splash crown, not a solid column or symmetric fountain. Second input is a shared water materials/style key ONLY, not pose or amount of water. Use clean luminous white foam, pale cyan/light-blue restrained cel shading and thin medium-blue contour accents. NO heavy black outline, navy shadow, dark cast shadow, dark puddle, gray haze or glow. No animals, ground, scenery, ocean horizon or text. Do not turn thin open source forms into a generic solid mound. Real alpha transparency in all background and holes. Complete shape and every droplet fully inside a comfortably padded canvas. Crisp smooth Cartoon artwork, not literal pixel art.
